profile.headline: Mobile Developer | Java - Kotlin - Flutter | Scrum Master Certified
profile.summary:
I am an a Software Engineer specializing in Android development currently working at NimbleRx.  

Competencies: Flutter, Kotlin, Jetpack Compose, Java, HTML, XML, SQL, Android Studio

positions.title: Software Engineer II
positions.description:
- Maintained fullstack long and short-range deliverables and implemented various bug fixes for the MI and MA lottery.
- Developed new features for proprietary Android applications using Kotlin / Java for phones and tablets
- Defined requirements with clients and company leadership then designed and deployed two games using Flutter /
Dart, then Integrated them into android applications.
- Adapted feature into android library so it can now be integrated into countless client applications
 - Collaborated with web devs to create react/express app to create coupons based off of client submitted information
- Used Terraform/AWS to create project infrastructure
- Developed architecture as well as UX/UI for POC applications.
- Managed tasks within Agile framework, cleared Sprinted tasks, and controlled JIRA workflows.
- Wrote unit and UI tests and created extensive application documentation for multiple projects-
positions.insights: Skills: Java · Kotlin · Flutter · Android Studio · Jetpack Compose

positions.title: Intern
positions.description:
- Remediated and coordinated the remediation of server vulnerabilities.
- Integrated Kautex’s zero waste policy into the server remediation process.
- Created detailed documentation for future use, greatly speeding up remediation time.
